citation.authors: Lee P, Le Saux M, Siegel R et al

cited_by.title: Being believed by doctors, and pain

record.population: 7,070 white, 3,125 Black, 1,538 Hispanic patients across 14 US emergency department studies
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of analgesia for acute pain
record.finding: Black patients were less likely than white patients to receive analgesia for acute pain (odds ratio 0.60, 95% CI 0.43 to 0.83).
record.note: US emergency departments only; observational studies.
